title: 47. Route requests around a consistent hash ring

examples.explanation: Hash 101 goes to the next server, at 500: `b`.
Hash 100 is exactly at the point of `a`.
Hash 999 is after the last server, so it wraps around to `a`.

hints: Use the left insertion position so equality selects the matching node.
An insertion index equal to the ring size wraps to index zero.
